title: Resetting a practice environment
passage:
Man: I copied yesterday’s case into the practice environment. The activity list still has a gap where a device stopped sending updates. If we connect a device during class, the gap may never appear.
Woman: I want every group to see the same gap. But don’t make them watch a recording of me choosing what to check. They need to decide whether to examine the device or the activity list first.
Man: Then I’ll replay just the incoming updates. The controls will still respond to whatever the learners choose. Should I put a message at the top saying the device disconnected?
Woman: Not until we go over the exercise. Last time two groups blamed the display at first. After I showed that message, both said the device had disconnected. I’d like to hear their first explanations this time too.
Man: Got it. I’ll add a shortcut to your screen that loads a fresh copy. Use it between groups, or the next group will see the earlier choices.
Woman: I can take care of that while the groups switch rooms.
passageZh:
男：我把昨天的案例複製到練習環境了。活動紀錄裡還有一段空白，當時有台裝置停止傳送更新。如果上課時才連接一台裝置，那段空白不見得會出現。
女：我希望每組都看到同一段空白。不過，不要讓大家看我示範選擇檢查項目的錄影。他們得自己決定要先檢查裝置，還是先看活動紀錄。
男：那我只重播收到的更新資料。操作畫面仍會依學員自行選擇的項目回應。要不要在最上面放一則訊息，說裝置已斷線？
女：等我們一起回顧練習時再顯示。上次有兩組一開始以為是顯示畫面的問題。我給他們看那則訊息後，兩組都說裝置斷線了。這次我也想先聽他們原先怎麼解釋。
男：了解。我會在你的操作畫面加一個捷徑，可載入全新的練習副本。請在換組時使用，不然下一組會看到上一組的選擇。
女：兩組換教室時，我會處理。
